BrochureContent.Content:
Set within a peaceful and highly regarded residential enclave, 9 Sycamore Walk is a beautifully presented detached bungalow offering bright, spacious and impeccably maintained accommodation extending over two levels. Ideally positioned close to Cabinteely, Cornelscourt and Foxrock, this is a home of real quality, elegance and warmth, presented in truly immaculate condition throughout.

The property has been upgraded, maintained and finished to an exceptional standard, with a level of care and attention immediately evident from the moment you step inside. The upgraded gas-fired central heating system, double-glazed windows, quality flooring, excellent built-in storage, beautifully appointed bathrooms and recently fitted custom handmade kitchen all combine to create a home that is stylish, comfortable and highly practical in equal measure.

The accommodation is arranged with a superb sense of flow and natural light. To the front, the living room features a beautiful bay window and an attractive timber fireplace with cast iron surround and marble hearth, creating an elegant and inviting reception space. Glazed double doors lead through to the impressive custom handmade kitchen, fitted with an extensive range of floor and eye-level units, marble worktops and upstand, integrated appliances and recessed lighting. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the bright dining/family room, where a Velux roof light and double doors provide a wonderful connection to the sunny rear garden.

The bedroom accommodation is particularly versatile, with three bedrooms at ground floor level and an impressive attic master suite above. The attic suite is a standout feature of the property, enjoying extensive wall-to-wall built-in wardrobes, eaves storage, recessed lighting, three Velux roof lights and a stylish en-suite shower room. It is a calm, bright and beautifully finished space, perfectly complementing the accommodation below.

Outside, the rear garden is a further highlight. Beautifully laid out in porcelain stone and lawn, it enjoys a sunny aspect and includes a lovely patio area, ideal for al fresco dining or simply enjoying long summer afternoons and evenings. To the front, there is off-street parking for two cars, an electric car charger and gated side access.

The location is superb. Sycamore Walk is within walking distance of Cabinteely, Cornelscourt and Foxrock villages, each offering a wonderful selection of cafés, boutiques, restaurants and everyday amenities. Tesco at The Park and Dunnes Stores Cornelscourt are both within easy reach, while Carrickmines Retail Park and Dundrum Town Centre are just a short drive away.

Cabinteely Park is on the doorstep, offering approximately 110 acres of green space, woodland trails, playing fields and a fantastic playground. Excellent schools are also close by, including St Brigid's National Schools and Loreto Foxrock. Transport links are excellent, with the LUAS at Carrickmines, the N11 QBC and the M50 all easily accessible.

9 Sycamore Walk offers turnkey luxury in a quiet, established and exceptionally convenient setting — a rare opportunity to acquire a home of outstanding quality, style and charm....
